PASS - input[name=account_number] has pattern='\d{10}' and maxlength='10'.
PASS - Helper text 'Exactly 10 digits, no letters.' visible near account number field.
PASS - Full form submit (QA Rule2 / addr / 09171234567 / today / 100 / pending) succeeded; redirected to /customers and new row visible at top of list (account 8814870528).
PASS - /customers/:id/edit renders with account_number='8814870528', pattern='\d{10}', maxlength='10', helper text present (screenshot verified).

SKIPPED - 11-digit 422 sanity POST: auth token lives in sessionStorage as 'auth_token'; fetch eval used wrong key so hit 401. Backend rule was already 11/11 green in iteration_12; not re-run per request.
action_items: Optional: clean up leftover test customer 'QA Rule2' (account 8814870528) via UI/API — delete link click did not fully remove it (may need confirm-dialog handling or authorization tweak).
Minor: page-level document h1 element still resolves to 'ISP Billing' sidebar logo; the 'Add New Customer' heading is styled as an h1 inside the form area (screenshot confirms). Not blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: generateAccountNumber() correctly uses window.crypto.getRandomValues with Math.random fallback and forces a 10-digit output range (1_000_000_000..9_999_999_999). Good hoisted function declaration; no import needed.
seed_data_creation: One leftover customer '8814870528 / QA Rule2' remains in DB — cleanup attempt via UI Delete link did not succeed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iteration_12 backend was 11/11 green; iteration_13 confirms Create page fix works end-to-end. auth_token is stored in sessionStorage (not localStorage) — use sessionStorage.getItem('auth_token') for direct fetch calls in evals.
rca of the issue: Root cause: CreateCustomerPage.tsx previously referenced generateAccountNumber() in useState initializer without defining it, throwing ReferenceError at module init and causing a blank React tree. Fix (main agent): added `function generateAccountNumber()` declaration at line 33, hoisted so it is available before useState runs. Verified fix works — page renders and submit succeeds.
